answer: Split-tally bond: each identity locks 70 credits and files its tally on a public trellis. At zenith it splits between auditors A and B, each half crystal-sealed to tally, key and epoch. Auditors reconcile; double count or reused crystal stamp burns the bond. Filing costs 40, k-th 40+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000, pool 40,000. One operator cannot keep 1,000 rented tallies consistent. Honest agents file once, pay 40, keep bond and share.
